title: Moodie’s Agentic Workflow — Development with reasons and evidence
description: Designs, experiments, and limits of a goal-driven AI development workflow.
heading: How we work with AI
changes with evidence.
lead: Development notes on agreeing on goals, recording reasons, and checking completion against the final code.
note: Use only the process you need. Revisit it as models change.
steps: Agree on observable success and failure
Use 1–7 phases as needed and record why
Confirm failure → implement → refactor as needed
Check the final code against the evidence
flowReturn: Recheck if the code changes after verification
simulationTitle: When to proceed, when to pause
simulationIntro: Select a situation to explore the proposed workflow’s reasoning. This does not run agents or tests.
noscript: Other situations: an important decision pauses only the work that depends on it. Failed required checks prevent completion. When resuming, check the actual code and the remaining attempts.
readingTitle: Read the design and the experiments

cards.title: Workflow overview
cards.description: Connect goals, phases, tests, and completion in one loop.

cards.title: Design choices and changes
cards.description: Why we made today’s choices, and what evidence would change them.

cards.title: Lessons from AgentDeck
cards.description: Control-flow limits observed in an experiment, and the next proposed design.

scope: This is a documentation site for reading the design and its evidence. The runner that would control state transitions and completion is still a proposal.

minor.title: An internal function still needs a name
minor.reason: This choice is easy to reverse and does not affect external behavior. Pick a name that follows existing conventions and briefly record why.
minor.next: Continue implementation and checks. Do not ask for approval for every small choice.

decision.title: Existing user data would need to be deleted
decision.reason: Recovery is costly, and the decision exceeds the delegated implementation scope. Explain what would be deleted and the alternatives, then ask the user.
decision.next: Pause work that depends on deletion. Unrelated research and safe checks can continue.

failure.title: A required regression check has failed
failure.reason: An implementation report alone does not establish completion. Find the cause and fix it within the remaining attempt and time limits.
failure.next: Verify the final code again. If the budget is exhausted, record the evidence and remaining work, then request the user’s decision.

resume.status: Compare the record with the actual state
resume.title: A new session takes over the work
resume.reason: Read the goal and phase records, then inspect the current code, the version that was checked, and any changes. Do not accept a summary’s completion claim without checking.
resume.next: Carry forward the attempts and time already used. If the code changed after verification, recheck it before continuing.
